## Plugin Type

- [ ] Substrate plugin (hardware backend)
- [ ] IR plugin (intermediate representation)
- [ ] Language binding
- [ ] Dispatch policy

## Plugin Name

Proposed name for the plugin (e.g., `sokr-vulkan`, `sokr-spirv`, `sokr-python`).

## Target

- **Substrate/IR/Language:** (e.g., Vulkan GPU, SPIR-V, Python)
- **Target hardware/software:** (e.g., NVIDIA RTX, AMD, Apple Silicon, Quantum processors)

## Description

Brief description of what this plugin enables.

## Motivation

Why is this plugin needed? What gap does it fill?

## Implementation Approach

- Key dependencies
- Integration points with SOKR core
- Any special considerations

## Maintainer Commitment

- [ ] I am willing to be the primary maintainer for this plugin
- [ ] I am willing to contribute initially but need co-maintainers
- [ ] I am proposing this for others to implement

Links to any related plugins, prior art, or references.
